projects.title: N-gram Computations with Data Smoothing
projects.description: Utilized American National Corpus and computed n-gram data before and after Good-Turing Smoothing to explore smoothing methods. Python.

projects.title: Abstractive Summarization for News Articles
projects.description: Designing natural language processing (NLP) project that extracts actor-action-receiver triples from text, computes part of speech tagging, performs semantic analysis, eliminates unnecessary data, and generates new sentences based on the remaining data. Java.
